provenance: Evaluator registry (Gate E). Succession is governed by EvaluatorSuccessionCase records under _mission/evolution/; an evaluator becomes INCUMBENT only through a valid succession case with a fully-passing bridge corpus and hidden holdout, judged by criteria fixed before the candidate existed. Rollback = restore the previous status fields (git revert).

known_blind_spots: morphological evasion: plural/gerund/past inflections of job terms slip through (proven by 3 live probes, 2026-08-19)

evaluators.mechanism: inflection-folded job-term matching (conservative suffix folding; >=2 terms collide)
known_blind_spots: synonym evasion (different words, same job) — folding is morphological only; semantic evasion needs a future succession with corroborated evidence
